title: Brain Stroke Detection
description: Built a platform to classify strokes into 3 classes (Normal, Bleeding, and Ischemia) and segment the stroke region in CT scans using various pretrained models. We built a segmentation-guided Ensemble model which is best model in terms of detection achieving a F1-score of 99.04% on test set.

title: American Sign Language Recognition
description: Built a real-time website to recognize ASL signs (digits and alphabets) using ML and DL models with live video feed processing. Among ML algorithms used, SVM achieved highest test acccuracy of 95%, while among DL models, ResNet50 achieved highest validation accuracy of 98.3%.
